final: WITH cat AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS aq, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS ad FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), m AS (SELECT AVG(ad) AS mean_ad FROM cat WHERE ad IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(cat.aq) AS avg_quantity, AVG(cat.ad) AS avg_cost_diff, AVG(cat.ad - m.mean_ad) AS avg_excess FROM cat, m WHERE cat.ad > m.mean_ad
